---
title: "Untitled"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(openintro)
library(tidyverse)

babies <- 
  babies %>% 
  mutate(
    smoke = as.logical(smoke),
    parity = as.logical(parity)
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(babies, aes(x = gestation, fill = parity)) + 
  geom_histogram() 

ggsave(filename = "img/default-plot.png", height = 2.25, width = 4)
```


```{r}
ggplot(babies, aes(x = gestation, fill = parity)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10) + 
  labs(
    x = "Gestation (days)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Parity"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d()

ggsave(filename = "img/improved-plot.png", height = 2.25, width = 4)
```
